.selected-move-score small { display: block; margin-top: .4rem; }
.classification-details { font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-heading { margin-top: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .move-list { position: relative; max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #594a34; border-radius: 6px; }
.notation-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-table th:first-child { width: 3.2rem; }
.notation-table thead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; background: var(--panel); }
.notation-table th { font-weight: normal; color: var(--bone-dim); padding: .4rem .2rem; }
.notation-table td { padding: .15rem; border-top: 1px solid #443b2e; }
.analysis-shell .notation-table .move-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: .4rem; font-size: .85rem; text-align: left; border-color: transparent; }
.analysis-shell [aria-current="step"] { background: #594521; color: #fff0c9; border-color: #e0bc67; }
.game-totals, .engine-workspace, .practice-workspace { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }
.promotion-dialog::backdrop { background: #000a; }
.promotion-dialog button { min-width: 72px; margin: .25rem; }
.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .board-column { grid-row: 2; }
  .review-column { grid-row: 3; }
  .workspace-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .workspace-heading .notice { display: none; }
  .workspace-heading > button { width: 100%; }
  .board-column, .review-column { grid-column: 1; position: static; padding: .6rem; }
  .board-column { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
  .board-with-evaluation { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .mobile-workspace-nav { display: flex; position: sticky; top: 60px; z-index: 20; gap: .5rem; padding: .4rem 0; background: var(--ink); }
  .mobile-workspace-nav button { flex: 1; background: var(--panel); font-size: .8rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }
  .analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 125px; }
  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }
}

/* Contain animated pieces; inline SVG baselines must not enlarge a square. */
.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.chat-message.user {
  background: var(--panel-raised);
  align-self: flex-end;
  max-width: 85%;
}

.chat-message.assistant {

}

}

.chat-input-row input {

  padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body);

}

.chat-input-row input:focus,
button:focus-visible {

  outline-offset: 1px;
}

.engine-bar {

  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--panel-raised);

}

.engine-bar-fill {

.summary-row {

}

.summary-row > * {

.summary-row > :nth-child(n+2) {

.summary-header {

.analysis-rows {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.analysis-row-button {

  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);

.analysis-row-button span:last-child {

  gap: 0.35rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.move-navigation button {
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.2rem;
}

.move-navigation-position {

  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--bone-dim);
}

.mate-distance-note {

  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  max-width: 32rem;
  text-align: left;
}

.position-editor {

  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 75, 0.2);
}

.position-editor-heading,
.editor-controls,
.castling-controls,
.piece-palette {

}

}

.piece-palette {

  margin: 0;

}

.position-editor textarea,
.position-editor input,
.position-editor select {
  background: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 75, 0.25);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--bone);
  padding: 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.position-editor textarea {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0.5rem 0;
}

.editor-controls label,
.castling-controls label {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--bone-dim);
}

.piece-palette {
  margin: 0.7rem 0;
}

.piece-palette button {
  min-width: 2rem;
  padding: 0.35rem;
}

.piece-palette .selected-piece {
  background: var(--brass);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.notice {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--bone-dim);
  font-style: italic;
}
.game-archive { margin-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--brass); padding-top: 1rem; }
.game-archive summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 0.5rem 0; }
.archive-import { display: block; margin-top: 1rem; }
.archive-import input { display: block; max-width: 100%; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.archive-list { padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.archive-list li { padding: 1rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--brass); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.archive-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.game-archive button { min-height: 44px; }

.workspace-panel { min-width: 0; }
.tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.tools-menu summary {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--brass);
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.tools-menu > summary { border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim); }
.tools-menu summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 1px; }
.tools-section { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 75, 0.2); }
.tools-section > :not(summary) { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.tools-menu button { min-height: 44px; }
.tools-menu textarea,
.tools-menu input,
.tools-menu select { max-width: 100%; }

  background: var(--ink);

  border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim);

  padding: 0.6rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}
.tools-chat .chat-panel { padding: 0.75rem; min-height: 360px; }

.tools-menu .analysis-row-button span { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.tools-menu .stat-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tools-menu .editor-controls label { flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0; }

/* Analysis workspace: centered board and a single contextual review. */
.analysis-shell { max-width: 1680px; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; }
.workspace-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.workspace-heading h1 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 0; }
.workspace-heading .notice { margin: .25rem 0 0; }
.eyebrow { color: var(--brass); font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 .2rem; }
.analysis-shell button, .analysis-shell select, .analysis-shell input:not([type="checkbox"]) { min-height: 44px; }
.analysis-shell :is(select, input:not([type="checkbox"])) { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bone); border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim); border-radius: 4px; padding: .4rem; font: inherit; }
.analysis-shell button { max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.analysis-shell :is(button, summary, a, textarea, select, input):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 2px; }
.analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }
.workspace-grid { --main-board-size: min(779px, calc(100dvh - 90px)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, calc(var(--main-board-size) + 50px)) minmax(320px, 1fr); grid-template-rows: max-content 1fr; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; margin: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.review-column .move-navigation-position { grid-column: auto; align-self: center; }
.board-settings { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.board-stage { min-width: 0; width: 100%; }
.board-evaluation { position: relative; align-self: stretch; }

.board-evaluation .engine-bar-fill { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100%; background: #eee; transition: height .15s ease; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] { background: #eee; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] .engine-bar-fill { background: #282828; }

.board-column .engine-arrow-status { font-size: .7rem; }
.review-column { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; padding: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .analysis-summary { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }

.selected-move { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.traceability { margin-top: .5rem; font-size: .8rem; }

.classification-details { font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-heading { margin-top: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .move-list { position: relative; max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #594a34; border-radius: 6px; }
.notation-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font-size: .8rem; }

.analysis-shell [aria-current="step"] { background: #594521; color: #fff0c9; border-color: #e0bc67; }
.game-totals, .engine-workspace, .practice-workspace { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }

  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }

.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.review-column h2, .selected-move h3 { font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.selected-move { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; font-size: .85rem; padding-right: .4rem; }
.explanation-empty { min-height: 100px; }
.analysis-shell summary { cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; padding: .65rem 0; color: var(--brass); font-size: .8rem; }
.traceability { margin-top: .5rem; font-size: .8rem; }
.selected-move-score small { display: block; margin-top: .4rem; }
.classification-details { font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-heading { margin-top: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .move-list { position: relative; max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #594a34; border-radius: 6px; }
.notation-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-table th:first-child { width: 3.2rem; }
.notation-table thead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; background: var(--panel); }
.notation-table th { font-weight: normal; color: var(--bone-dim); padding: .4rem .2rem; }
.notation-table td { padding: .15rem; border-top: 1px solid #443b2e; }
.analysis-shell .notation-table .move-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: .4rem; font-size: .85rem; text-align: left; border-color: transparent; }
.analysis-shell [aria-current="step"] { background: #594521; color: #fff0c9; border-color: #e0bc67; }
.game-totals, .engine-workspace, .practice-workspace { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }
.promotion-dialog::backdrop { background: #000a; }
.promotion-dialog button { min-width: 72px; margin: .25rem; }
.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .board-column { grid-row: 2; }
  .review-column { grid-row: 3; }
  .workspace-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .workspace-heading .notice { display: none; }
  .workspace-heading > button { width: 100%; }
  .board-column, .review-column { grid-column: 1; position: static; padding: .6rem; }
  .board-column { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
  .board-with-evaluation { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .mobile-workspace-nav { display: flex; position: sticky; top: 60px; z-index: 20; gap: .5rem; padding: .4rem 0; background: var(--ink); }
  .mobile-workspace-nav button { flex: 1; background: var(--panel); font-size: .8rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }
  .analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 125px; }
  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }
}

/* Contain animated pieces; inline SVG baselines must not enlarge a square. */
.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }
.promotion-dialog::backdrop { background: #000a; }
.promotion-dialog button { min-width: 72px; margin: .25rem; }
.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .board-column { grid-row: 2; }
  .review-column { grid-row: 3; }
  .workspace-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .workspace-heading .notice { display: none; }
  .workspace-heading > button { width: 100%; }
  .board-column, .review-column { grid-column: 1; position: static; padding: .6rem; }
  .board-column { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
  .board-with-evaluation { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .mobile-workspace-nav { display: flex; position: sticky; top: 60px; z-index: 20; gap: .5rem; padding: .4rem 0; background: var(--ink); }
  .mobile-workspace-nav button { flex: 1; background: var(--panel); font-size: .8rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }
  .analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 125px; }
  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }
}

/* Contain animated pieces; inline SVG baselines must not enlarge a square. */
.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.analysis-shell button { max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.analysis-shell :is(button, summary, a, textarea, select, input):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 2px; }
.analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }

.workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; margin: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.review-column .board-view-controls { font-size: .75rem; }

.board-evaluation { position: relative; align-self: stretch; }

.board-evaluation .engine-bar-fill { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100%; background: #eee; transition: height .15s ease; }

.notation-table td { padding: .15rem; border-top: 1px solid #443b2e; }
.analysis-shell .notation-table .move-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: .4rem; font-size: .85rem; text-align: left; border-color: transparent; }

.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }

.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }
.promotion-dialog::backdrop { background: #000a; }
.promotion-dialog button { min-width: 72px; margin: .25rem; }
.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .board-column { grid-row: 2; }
  .review-column { grid-row: 3; }
  .workspace-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .workspace-heading .notice { display: none; }
  .workspace-heading > button { width: 100%; }
  .board-column, .review-column { grid-column: 1; position: static; padding: .6rem; }
  .board-column { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
  .board-with-evaluation { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .mobile-workspace-nav { display: flex; position: sticky; top: 60px; z-index: 20; gap: .5rem; padding: .4rem 0; background: var(--ink); }
  .mobile-workspace-nav button { flex: 1; background: var(--panel); font-size: .8rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }

  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }

.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }
.promotion-dialog::backdrop { background: #000a; }
.promotion-dialog button { min-width: 72px; margin: .25rem; }
.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .board-column { grid-row: 2; }
  .review-column { grid-row: 3; }
  .workspace-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .workspace-heading .notice { display: none; }
  .workspace-heading > button { width: 100%; }
  .board-column, .review-column { grid-column: 1; position: static; padding: .6rem; }
  .board-column { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
  .board-with-evaluation { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .mobile-workspace-nav { display: flex; position: sticky; top: 60px; z-index: 20; gap: .5rem; padding: .4rem 0; background: var(--ink); }
  .mobile-workspace-nav button { flex: 1; background: var(--panel); font-size: .8rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }
  .analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 125px; }
  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }
}

/* Contain animated pieces; inline SVG baselines must not enlarge a square. */
.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.board-with-evaluation { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
@media (min-width: 761px) {
  .app-navigation { padding-block: .2rem; }

}
.review-column .move-navigation { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(44px, 1fr)) auto; margin-top: .35rem; }
.review-column .move-navigation-position { grid-column: auto; align-self: center; }
.board-settings { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.board-stage { min-width: 0; width: 100%; }
.board-evaluation { position: relative; align-self: stretch; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar { position: absolute; inset: 0; height: 100%; width: 100%; margin: 0; background: #282828; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #777; overflow: hidden; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar-fill { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100%; background: #eee; transition: height .15s ease; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] { background: #eee; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] .engine-bar-fill { background: #282828; }
.engine-bar-score { position: absolute; bottom: 5px; left: 0; right: 0; color: #fff; background: #333d; text-align: center; font-size: .6rem; font-weight: bold; }
.board-column .engine-arrow-status { font-size: .7rem; }
.review-column { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; padding: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .analysis-summary { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.review-column h2, .selected-move h3 { font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }

.explanation-empty { min-height: 100px; }
.analysis-shell summary { cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; padding: .65rem 0; color: var(--brass); font-size: .8rem; }
.traceability { margin-top: .5rem; font-size: .8rem; }
.selected-move-score small { display: block; margin-top: .4rem; }
.classification-details { font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-heading { margin-top: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .move-list { position: relative; max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #594a34; border-radius: 6px; }
.notation-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-table th:first-child { width: 3.2rem; }

.notation-table th { font-weight: normal; color: var(--bone-dim); padding: .4rem .2rem; }
.notation-table td { padding: .15rem; border-top: 1px solid #443b2e; }
.analysis-shell .notation-table .move-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: .4rem; font-size: .85rem; text-align: left; border-color: transparent; }

.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }

.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }

.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }

  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }

.analysis-shell button, .analysis-shell select, .analysis-shell input:not([type="checkbox"]) { min-height: 44px; }

.analysis-shell button { max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.analysis-shell :is(button, summary, a, textarea, select, input):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 2px; }
.analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }

.review-column .board-view-controls { font-size: .75rem; }

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body, #root {

}

body {

.app-shell {

.eco-label {

.move-list {

.chat-message.user {

  align-self: flex-end;
  max-width: 85%;
}

.chat-message.assistant {

}

.chat-message.error {

}

  color: var(--bone);
  padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.chat-input-row input:focus,
button:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--brass);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

.engine-bar {

  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--panel-raised);

.engine-bar-fill {

.summary-row {

.summary-row > :nth-child(n+2) {

.summary-header {

.analysis-rows {

  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.analysis-row-button {

  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;

.analysis-row-button span:last-child {

  gap: 0.35rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.move-navigation button {
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.2rem;
}

.move-navigation-position {

  text-align: center;

  font-size: 0.8rem;

}

.mate-distance-note {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  max-width: 32rem;
  text-align: left;
}

  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 75, 0.2);
}

.position-editor-heading,
.editor-controls,
.castling-controls,
.piece-palette {

}

.position-editor input,
.position-editor select {
  background: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 75, 0.25);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--bone);
  padding: 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.position-editor textarea {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0.5rem 0;
}

.editor-controls label,
.castling-controls label {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--bone-dim);
}

.piece-palette {
  margin: 0.7rem 0;
}

.piece-palette button {
  min-width: 2rem;
  padding: 0.35rem;
}

  color: var(--ink);
}

.notice {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--bone-dim);
  font-style: italic;
}
.game-archive { margin-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--brass); padding-top: 1rem; }
.game-archive summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 0.5rem 0; }
.archive-import { display: block; margin-top: 1rem; }
.archive-import input { display: block; max-width: 100%; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.archive-list { padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.archive-list li { padding: 1rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--brass); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.archive-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.game-archive button { min-height: 44px; }

.workspace-panel { min-width: 0; }
.tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.tools-menu summary {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--brass);
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.tools-menu > summary { border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim); }
.tools-menu summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 1px; }
.tools-section { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 75, 0.2); }
.tools-section > :not(summary) { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.tools-menu button { min-height: 44px; }
.tools-menu textarea,
.tools-menu input,
.tools-menu select { max-width: 100%; }

  border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim);

}

.tools-menu .analysis-row-button span { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.tools-menu .stat-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tools-menu .editor-controls label { flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0; }

/* Analysis workspace: centered board and a single contextual review. */
.analysis-shell { max-width: 1680px; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; }
.workspace-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.workspace-heading h1 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 0; }
.workspace-heading .notice { margin: .25rem 0 0; }
.eyebrow { color: var(--brass); font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 .2rem; }
.analysis-shell button, .analysis-shell select, .analysis-shell input:not([type="checkbox"]) { min-height: 44px; }
.analysis-shell :is(select, input:not([type="checkbox"])) { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bone); border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim); border-radius: 4px; padding: .4rem; font: inherit; }
.analysis-shell button { max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.analysis-shell :is(button, summary, a, textarea, select, input):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 2px; }
.analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }
.workspace-grid { --main-board-size: min(779px, calc(100dvh - 90px)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, calc(var(--main-board-size) + 50px)) minmax(320px, 1fr); grid-template-rows: max-content 1fr; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }

.board-settings { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }

.board-evaluation { position: relative; align-self: stretch; }

.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] .engine-bar-fill { background: #282828; }

.board-column .engine-arrow-status { font-size: .7rem; }
.review-column { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; padding: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .analysis-summary { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }

.traceability { margin-top: .5rem; font-size: .8rem; }

.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }

.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }

  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }

.notation-table th { font-weight: normal; color: var(--bone-dim); padding: .4rem .2rem; }
.notation-table td { padding: .15rem; border-top: 1px solid #443b2e; }
.analysis-shell .notation-table .move-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: .4rem; font-size: .85rem; text-align: left; border-color: transparent; }
.analysis-shell [aria-current="step"] { background: #594521; color: #fff0c9; border-color: #e0bc67; }
.game-totals, .engine-workspace, .practice-workspace { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }
.promotion-dialog::backdrop { background: #000a; }
.promotion-dialog button { min-width: 72px; margin: .25rem; }
.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .board-column { grid-row: 2; }
  .review-column { grid-row: 3; }
  .workspace-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .workspace-heading .notice { display: none; }
  .workspace-heading > button { width: 100%; }
  .board-column, .review-column { grid-column: 1; position: static; padding: .6rem; }
  .board-column { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
  .board-with-evaluation { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .mobile-workspace-nav { display: flex; position: sticky; top: 60px; z-index: 20; gap: .5rem; padding: .4rem 0; background: var(--ink); }
  .mobile-workspace-nav button { flex: 1; background: var(--panel); font-size: .8rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }
  .analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 125px; }
  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }
}

/* Contain animated pieces; inline SVG baselines must not enlarge a square. */
.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; font-size: .85rem; padding-right: .4rem; }
.explanation-empty { min-height: 100px; }
.analysis-shell summary { cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; padding: .65rem 0; color: var(--brass); font-size: .8rem; }
.traceability { margin-top: .5rem; font-size: .8rem; }
.selected-move-score small { display: block; margin-top: .4rem; }
.classification-details { font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-heading { margin-top: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .move-list { position: relative; max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #594a34; border-radius: 6px; }
.notation-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-table th:first-child { width: 3.2rem; }
.notation-table thead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; background: var(--panel); }
.notation-table th { font-weight: normal; color: var(--bone-dim); padding: .4rem .2rem; }
.notation-table td { padding: .15rem; border-top: 1px solid #443b2e; }
.analysis-shell .notation-table .move-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: .4rem; font-size: .85rem; text-align: left; border-color: transparent; }
.analysis-shell [aria-current="step"] { background: #594521; color: #fff0c9; border-color: #e0bc67; }
.game-totals, .engine-workspace, .practice-workspace { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }
.promotion-dialog::backdrop { background: #000a; }
.promotion-dialog button { min-width: 72px; margin: .25rem; }
.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .board-column { grid-row: 2; }
  .review-column { grid-row: 3; }
  .workspace-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .workspace-heading .notice { display: none; }
  .workspace-heading > button { width: 100%; }
  .board-column, .review-column { grid-column: 1; position: static; padding: .6rem; }
  .board-column { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
  .board-with-evaluation { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .mobile-workspace-nav { display: flex; position: sticky; top: 60px; z-index: 20; gap: .5rem; padding: .4rem 0; background: var(--ink); }
  .mobile-workspace-nav button { flex: 1; background: var(--panel); font-size: .8rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }
  .analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 125px; }
  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }
}

/* Contain animated pieces; inline SVG baselines must not enlarge a square. */
.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.chat-message.user {

}

.chat-message.assistant {

}

  padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body);

}

.chat-input-row input:focus,
button:focus-visible {

}

.engine-bar {

  background: var(--panel-raised);

}

.engine-bar-fill {

.summary-row {

.summary-row > :nth-child(n+2) {

.summary-header {

.analysis-rows {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.analysis-row-button {

  font-family: var(--font-mono);

.analysis-row-button span:last-child {

  gap: 0.35rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.move-navigation button {
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.2rem;
}

.move-navigation-position {

}

.mate-distance-note {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  max-width: 32rem;
  text-align: left;
}

.position-editor {

  border-top: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 75, 0.2);
}

.position-editor-heading,
.editor-controls,
.castling-controls,
.piece-palette {

}

}

}

.position-editor textarea,
.position-editor input,
.position-editor select {
  background: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 75, 0.25);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--bone);
  padding: 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.position-editor textarea {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0.5rem 0;
}

.editor-controls label,
.castling-controls label {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--bone-dim);
}

.piece-palette {
  margin: 0.7rem 0;
}

.piece-palette button {
  min-width: 2rem;
  padding: 0.35rem;
}

.piece-palette .selected-piece {
  background: var(--brass);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.notice {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--bone-dim);
  font-style: italic;
}
.game-archive { margin-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--brass); padding-top: 1rem; }
.game-archive summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 0.5rem 0; }
.archive-import { display: block; margin-top: 1rem; }
.archive-import input { display: block; max-width: 100%; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.archive-list { padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.archive-list li { padding: 1rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--brass); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.archive-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.game-archive button { min-height: 44px; }

.workspace-panel { min-width: 0; }
.tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.tools-menu summary {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--brass);
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.tools-menu > summary { border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim); }
.tools-menu summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 1px; }
.tools-section { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 75, 0.2); }
.tools-section > :not(summary) { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.tools-menu button { min-height: 44px; }
.tools-menu textarea,
.tools-menu input,
.tools-menu select { max-width: 100%; }

  padding: 0.6rem;

}

.tools-menu .analysis-row-button span { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.tools-menu .stat-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tools-menu .editor-controls label { flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0; }

/* Analysis workspace: centered board and a single contextual review. */
.analysis-shell { max-width: 1680px; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; }
.workspace-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.workspace-heading h1 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 0; }
.workspace-heading .notice { margin: .25rem 0 0; }
.eyebrow { color: var(--brass); font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 .2rem; }
.analysis-shell button, .analysis-shell select, .analysis-shell input:not([type="checkbox"]) { min-height: 44px; }
.analysis-shell :is(select, input:not([type="checkbox"])) { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bone); border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim); border-radius: 4px; padding: .4rem; font: inherit; }
.analysis-shell button { max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.analysis-shell :is(button, summary, a, textarea, select, input):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 2px; }
.analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }
.workspace-grid { --main-board-size: min(779px, calc(100dvh - 90px)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, calc(var(--main-board-size) + 50px)) minmax(320px, 1fr); grid-template-rows: max-content 1fr; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; margin: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.review-column .move-navigation-position { grid-column: auto; align-self: center; }
.board-settings { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.board-stage { min-width: 0; width: 100%; }
.board-evaluation { position: relative; align-self: stretch; }

.board-evaluation .engine-bar-fill { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100%; background: #eee; transition: height .15s ease; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] { background: #eee; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] .engine-bar-fill { background: #282828; }

.board-column .engine-arrow-status { font-size: .7rem; }
.review-column { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; padding: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .analysis-summary { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }

.traceability { margin-top: .5rem; font-size: .8rem; }

.classification-details { font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-heading { margin-top: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .move-list { position: relative; max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #594a34; border-radius: 6px; }
.notation-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font-size: .8rem; }

.analysis-shell [aria-current="step"] { background: #594521; color: #fff0c9; border-color: #e0bc67; }
.game-totals, .engine-workspace, .practice-workspace { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }

  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }

.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

/* Analysis workspace: centered board and a single contextual review. */
.analysis-shell { max-width: 1680px; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; }
.workspace-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.workspace-heading h1 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 0; }
.workspace-heading .notice { margin: .25rem 0 0; }
.eyebrow { color: var(--brass); font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 .2rem; }
.analysis-shell button, .analysis-shell select, .analysis-shell input:not([type="checkbox"]) { min-height: 44px; }
.analysis-shell :is(select, input:not([type="checkbox"])) { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bone); border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim); border-radius: 4px; padding: .4rem; font: inherit; }
.analysis-shell button { max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.analysis-shell :is(button, summary, a, textarea, select, input):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 2px; }
.analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }
.workspace-grid { --main-board-size: min(779px, calc(100dvh - 90px)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, calc(var(--main-board-size) + 50px)) minmax(320px, 1fr); grid-template-rows: max-content 1fr; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; margin: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.workspace-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.board-column { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 2; position: sticky; top: 60px; padding: .5rem; }
.review-column .board-view-controls { font-size: .75rem; }
.move-sound-control { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; font-size: .75rem; }

.board-settings { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.board-stage { min-width: 0; width: 100%; }
.board-evaluation { position: relative; align-self: stretch; }

.board-evaluation .engine-bar-fill { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100%; background: #eee; transition: height .15s ease; }

.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] .engine-bar-fill { background: #282828; }
.engine-bar-score { position: absolute; bottom: 5px; left: 0; right: 0; color: #fff; background: #333d; text-align: center; font-size: .6rem; font-weight: bold; }
.board-column .engine-arrow-status { font-size: .7rem; }
.review-column { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; padding: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .analysis-summary { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.review-column h2, .selected-move h3 { font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }

.selected-move-score small { display: block; margin-top: .4rem; }
.classification-details { font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-heading { margin-top: .75rem; }

.notation-table th { font-weight: normal; color: var(--bone-dim); padding: .4rem .2rem; }
.notation-table td { padding: .15rem; border-top: 1px solid #443b2e; }
.analysis-shell .notation-table .move-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: .4rem; font-size: .85rem; text-align: left; border-color: transparent; }
.analysis-shell [aria-current="step"] { background: #594521; color: #fff0c9; border-color: #e0bc67; }
.game-totals, .engine-workspace, .practice-workspace { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }

@media (max-width: 760px) {

  width: 100%;
  resize: vertical;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--bone);
  border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0.6rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}
.tools-chat .chat-panel { padding: 0.75rem; min-height: 360px; }
.tools-menu .analysis-row-button { flex-wrap: wrap; max-width: 100%; text-align: left; }
.tools-menu .analysis-row-button span { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.tools-menu .stat-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tools-menu .editor-controls label { flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0; }

/* Analysis workspace: centered board and a single contextual review. */
.analysis-shell { max-width: 1680px; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; }
.workspace-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.workspace-heading h1 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 0; }
.workspace-heading .notice { margin: .25rem 0 0; }
.eyebrow { color: var(--brass); font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 .2rem; }
.analysis-shell button, .analysis-shell select, .analysis-shell input:not([type="checkbox"]) { min-height: 44px; }
.analysis-shell :is(select, input:not([type="checkbox"])) { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bone); border: 1px solid var(--brass-dim); border-radius: 4px; padding: .4rem; font: inherit; }
.analysis-shell button { max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.analysis-shell :is(button, summary, a, textarea, select, input):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 2px; }
.analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }
.workspace-grid { --main-board-size: min(779px, calc(100dvh - 90px)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, calc(var(--main-board-size) + 50px)) minmax(320px, 1fr); grid-template-rows: max-content 1fr; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; margin: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.workspace-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.board-column { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 2; position: sticky; top: 60px; padding: .5rem; }
.review-column .board-view-controls { font-size: .75rem; }
.move-sound-control { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; font-size: .75rem; }
.board-with-evaluation { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
@media (min-width: 761px) {
  .app-navigation { padding-block: .2rem; }
  .app-navigation a { min-height: 40px; padding-block: .35rem; }
  .analysis-shell { padding-block: .5rem; }
  .board-with-evaluation { width: calc(var(--main-board-size) + 32px); max-width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
}
.review-column .move-navigation { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(44px, 1fr)) auto; margin-top: .35rem; }
.review-column .move-navigation-position { grid-column: auto; align-self: center; }
.board-settings { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.board-stage { min-width: 0; width: 100%; }
.board-evaluation { position: relative; align-self: stretch; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar { position: absolute; inset: 0; height: 100%; width: 100%; margin: 0; background: #282828; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #777; overflow: hidden; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar-fill { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100%; background: #eee; transition: height .15s ease; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] { background: #eee; }
.board-evaluation .engine-bar[data-orientation="black"] .engine-bar-fill { background: #282828; }
.engine-bar-score { position: absolute; bottom: 5px; left: 0; right: 0; color: #fff; background: #333d; text-align: center; font-size: .6rem; font-weight: bold; }
.board-column .engine-arrow-status { font-size: .7rem; }
.review-column { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; padding: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .analysis-summary { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.review-column h2, .selected-move h3 { font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.selected-move { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; font-size: .85rem; padding-right: .4rem; }
.explanation-empty { min-height: 100px; }
.analysis-shell summary { cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; padding: .65rem 0; color: var(--brass); font-size: .8rem; }
.traceability { margin-top: .5rem; font-size: .8rem; }
.selected-move-score small { display: block; margin-top: .4rem; }
.classification-details { font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-heading { margin-top: .75rem; }
.analysis-shell .move-list { position: relative; max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #594a34; border-radius: 6px; }
.notation-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-table th:first-child { width: 3.2rem; }
.notation-table thead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; background: var(--panel); }
.notation-table th { font-weight: normal; color: var(--bone-dim); padding: .4rem .2rem; }
.notation-table td { padding: .15rem; border-top: 1px solid #443b2e; }
.analysis-shell .notation-table .move-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: .4rem; font-size: .85rem; text-align: left; border-color: transparent; }
.analysis-shell [aria-current="step"] { background: #594521; color: #fff0c9; border-color: #e0bc67; }
.game-totals, .engine-workspace, .practice-workspace { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }
.promotion-dialog::backdrop { background: #000a; }
.promotion-dialog button { min-width: 72px; margin: .25rem; }
.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .board-column { grid-row: 2; }
  .review-column { grid-row: 3; }
  .workspace-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .workspace-heading .notice { display: none; }
  .workspace-heading > button { width: 100%; }
  .board-column, .review-column { grid-column: 1; position: static; padding: .6rem; }
  .board-column { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
  .board-with-evaluation { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .mobile-workspace-nav { display: flex; position: sticky; top: 60px; z-index: 20; gap: .5rem; padding: .4rem 0; background: var(--ink); }
  .mobile-workspace-nav button { flex: 1; background: var(--panel); font-size: .8rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }
  .analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 125px; }
  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }
}

/* Contain animated pieces; inline SVG baselines must not enlarge a square. */
.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.analysis-shell .move-list { position: relative; max-height: 300px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #594a34; border-radius: 6px; }
.notation-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font-size: .8rem; }
.notation-table th:first-child { width: 3.2rem; }
.notation-table thead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; background: var(--panel); }
.notation-table th { font-weight: normal; color: var(--bone-dim); padding: .4rem .2rem; }
.notation-table td { padding: .15rem; border-top: 1px solid #443b2e; }
.analysis-shell .notation-table .move-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: .4rem; font-size: .85rem; text-align: left; border-color: transparent; }
.analysis-shell [aria-current="step"] { background: #594521; color: #fff0c9; border-color: #e0bc67; }
.game-totals, .engine-workspace, .practice-workspace { border-top: 1px solid #594a34; margin-top: .75rem; }
.engine-controls { font-size: .8rem; }
.engine-controls button { margin: .2rem .3rem .2rem 0; }
.practice-launcher { align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
.game-notice { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.game-tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }
.game-tools-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.analysis-shell .tools-menu { margin-top: 1rem; }
.analysis-shell .tools-chat .chat-panel { max-height: 600px; }
.mobile-workspace-nav { display: none; }
.promotion-dialog { color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--brass); border-radius: 12px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; }
.promotion-dialog::backdrop { background: #000a; }
.promotion-dialog button { min-width: 72px; margin: .25rem; }
.promotion-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .analysis-shell { padding: .5rem; }
  .workspace-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .workspace-grid > .workspace-heading { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .board-column { grid-row: 2; }
  .review-column { grid-row: 3; }
  .workspace-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .workspace-heading .notice { display: none; }
  .workspace-heading > button { width: 100%; }
  .board-column, .review-column { grid-column: 1; position: static; padding: .6rem; }
  .board-column { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; }
  .board-with-evaluation { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .mobile-workspace-nav { display: flex; position: sticky; top: 60px; z-index: 20; gap: .5rem; padding: .4rem 0; background: var(--ink); }
  .mobile-workspace-nav button { flex: 1; background: var(--panel); font-size: .8rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }
  .analysis-shell section, .analysis-shell details { scroll-margin-top: 125px; }
  .selected-move .move-explanation { max-height: 320px; }
  .game-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .75rem; }
}

/* Contain animated pieces; inline SVG baselines must not enlarge a square. */
.board-stage { overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
.board-stage [data-piece] > svg { display: block; }
.exploration-notice { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.opening-study-actions, .opening-training-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-top: 1rem; }
.opening-library .opening-primary { background: var(--brass); color: #21190c; border-color: var(--brass); font-weight: 600; }
.opening-notes { border-top: 1px solid #54432f; margin-top: 1.5rem; padding-top: 1.2rem; }

.opening-notes p, .opening-notes li { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-notes ul { padding-left: 1.1rem; margin-top: .5rem; }
.opening-notes li { margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.opening-plan-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.3rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
.opening-library .opening-small { font-size: .75rem; color: #b5aa94; }

.opening-color-choice { display: flex; gap: .5rem; align-items: center; font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-training progress { width: 100%; height: 7px; accent-color: var(--brass); }
.opening-training form { display: flex; align-items: end; gap: .5rem; margin-top: .8rem; }

.opening-feedback { color: #e8cd91; min-height: 1.5em; font-size: .9rem; }
.opening-practice-stats { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-trap-list { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
.opening-trap-list > p { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .85rem; }

.opening-trap-list article p { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-library .opening-back-link { margin-bottom: .8rem; font-size: .8rem; }

.opening-source summary { cursor: pointer; }
.opening-source pre { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: .68rem; }

.opening-course-header h1 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem,3vw,2.4rem); margin: .3rem 0 .6rem; }
.opening-course-header p { color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-course-header button { flex-shrink: 0; }

.opening-library .opening-family-card { display: grid; gap: .7rem; text-align: left; padding: 1.2rem; background: var(--panel); }
.opening-family-card span { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }

.opening-focus .opening-layout { display: block; }

.opening-focus .opening-board { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3 / span 2; max-width: 620px; align-self: start; }

.opening-notation { margin: .7rem 0; }

.opening-branches { margin: 1rem 0; padding-top: .6rem; border-top: 1px solid #51432f; }

.opening-turn-review { display: grid; gap: .8rem; padding: .5rem 0; }

.opening-journey-stages li[aria-current="step"] { color: #f6d894; border-color: var(--brass); }
.opening-reply, .opening-recap { padding: .7rem; margin-top: 1rem; border-left: 3px solid var(--brass); background: #372c1e; font-size: .85rem; }
.opening-reply p { margin: .35rem 0 0; }
.opening-board { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; border: 3px solid #57452d; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; }
.opening-board-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; padding: .75rem 0; }
.opening-board-controls span { min-width: 60px; text-align: center; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-move-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem; max-height: 165px; overflow-y: auto; background: #211b15; border-radius: 6px; padding: .5rem; }
.opening-library .opening-move-strip button { border-color: transparent; padding: .25rem .4rem; min-height: 36px; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-move-strip button[aria-current="step"] { color: #1b1712; background: var(--brass); }
.opening-study-actions, .opening-training-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-top: 1rem; }
.opening-library .opening-primary { background: var(--brass); color: #21190c; border-color: var(--brass); font-weight: 600; }
.opening-notes { border-top: 1px solid #54432f; margin-top: 1.5rem; padding-top: 1.2rem; }
.opening-notes h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; color: #ead5ad; }
.opening-notes p, .opening-notes li { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-notes ul { padding-left: 1.1rem; margin-top: .5rem; }
.opening-notes li { margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.opening-plan-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.3rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
.opening-library .opening-small { font-size: .75rem; color: #b5aa94; }
.opening-variant-note, .opening-hint { border-left: 3px solid var(--brass); padding: .7rem; background: #372c1e; border-radius: 3px; }
.opening-training { padding-top: 1rem; }
.opening-color-choice { display: flex; gap: .5rem; align-items: center; font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-training progress { width: 100%; height: 7px; accent-color: var(--brass); }
.opening-training form { display: flex; align-items: end; gap: .5rem; margin-top: .8rem; }
.opening-training form label { display: grid; gap: .35rem; flex: 1; font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-feedback { color: #e8cd91; min-height: 1.5em; font-size: .9rem; }
.opening-practice-stats { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-trap-list { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
.opening-trap-list > p { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .85rem; }
.opening-trap-list article { border: 1px solid #5b4830; background: #231d16; border-radius: 7px; padding: 1rem; }
.opening-trap-list article p { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-library .opening-back-link { margin-bottom: .8rem; font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-source { font-size: .72rem; color: #b5aa94; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
.opening-source a { color: var(--brass); }
.opening-source details { margin-top: .6rem; }
.opening-source summary { cursor: pointer; }
.opening-source pre { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: .68rem; }
.opening-course-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 1.5rem; margin: 1rem 0 2rem; }
.opening-course-header h1 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem,3vw,2.4rem); margin: .3rem 0 .6rem; }
.opening-course-header p { color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-course-header button { flex-shrink: 0; }
.opening-course-search { display: grid; gap: .5rem; max-width: 500px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-family-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: .7rem; }
.opening-library .opening-family-card { display: grid; gap: .7rem; text-align: left; padding: 1.2rem; background: var(--panel); }
.opening-family-card span { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-course-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
.opening-course-card { padding: 1.4rem; border: 1px solid #51432f; background: var(--panel); border-radius: 9px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: start; }
.opening-course-card h2 { font-size: 1.35rem; margin: .3rem 0 .7rem; }
.opening-course-card p:not(.opening-eyebrow) { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.6; }
.opening-course-card button { margin-top: auto; }
.opening-focus .opening-layout { display: block; }
.opening-focus .opening-workbench { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(280px,.85fr); gap: 1.25rem 1.6rem; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; }
.opening-focus .opening-line-heading { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-bottom: 0; }
.opening-lesson-toolbar { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .8rem; padding-bottom: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #51432f; }
.opening-lesson-toolbar > span { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-lesson-toolbar details { position: relative; font-size: .85rem; }
.opening-lesson-toolbar summary, .opening-sequence summary, .opening-notation summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--bone-dim); padding: .5rem 0; font-size: .85rem; }
.opening-lesson-toolbar details[open] { flex-basis: 100%; padding: .8rem; border: 1px solid #51432f; border-radius: 6px; }
.opening-lesson-toolbar details button { margin: .4rem .5rem .2rem 0; }
.opening-focus .opening-board { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3 / span 2; max-width: 620px; align-self: start; }
.opening-focus .opening-coach { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; border: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; margin: 0; }
.opening-focus .opening-coach h3 { margin-top: .3rem; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-focus .opening-coach-question { line-height: 1.7; font-size: 1.12rem; border: 0; padding: 0; }
.opening-focus .opening-training { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 4; padding: 0; align-self: start; }
.opening-focus .opening-notes { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: .2rem; }
.opening-focus .opening-reply { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-focus .opening-opponent { border-left: 2px solid #78603c; padding: .1rem 0 .1rem .8rem; margin: .5rem 0 1rem; font-size: .88rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-focus .opening-recap { border-left-width: 2px; }
.opening-notation { margin: .7rem 0; }
.opening-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; margin: .6rem 0; }
.opening-library .opening-option input { width: auto; accent-color: var(--brass); }
.opening-branches { margin: 1rem 0; padding-top: .6rem; border-top: 1px solid #51432f; }
.opening-branches summary, .opening-other-routes summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--brass); font-size: .85rem; padding: .5rem 0; }
.opening-branch-options { display: grid; gap: .5rem; }
.opening-branch-options button { display: grid; gap: .4rem; text-align: left; }
.opening-branch-options span { font-size: .73rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-other-routes { margin-top: 1rem; }
.opening-other-routes button { display: block; width: 100%; margin: .5rem 0; text-align: left; }
.opening-practical-list { margin: 1.5rem 0; padding-top: .8rem; border-top: 1px solid #51432f; }
.opening-practical-list summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--brass); }
.opening-practical-list button { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; margin: .6rem 0; }
.opening-arrow-key { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem .8rem; font-size: .7rem; margin: .2rem 0; }
.opening-arrow-key span:nth-child(1) { color: #f38c82; }
.opening-arrow-key span:nth-child(2) { color: #e8c36a; }
.opening-arrow-key span:nth-child(3) { color: #74c8b3; }
.opening-turn-review { display: grid; gap: .8rem; padding: .5rem 0; }
.opening-turn-review section { border-left: 2px solid var(--brass); padding-left: .75rem; }
.opening-turn-review h4 { margin: 0 0 .35rem; color: var(--brass); font-size: .85rem; }
.opening-turn-review p { margin: .35rem 0; font-size: .85rem; line-height: 1.5; }
@media(max-width:760px){
  .opening-library { padding: .75rem; }
  .opening-hero { gap: 1rem; }
  .opening-totals { padding-left: .8rem; }
  .opening-totals strong { font-size: 1.6rem; }
  .opening-totals span { font-size: .65rem; max-width: 95px; }
  .opening-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
  .opening-results { max-height: 250px; }
  .opening-workbench { padding: .75rem; }
  .opening-hero h1 { font-size: 1.45rem; }
  .opening-hero p:last-child { font-size: .8rem; }
  .opening-line-heading h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
  .opening-plan-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: .5rem; }
  .opening-course-header { display: block; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
  .opening-course-header button { margin-top: .7rem; }
  .opening-family-grid, .opening-course-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .opening-course-card { padding: 1.1rem; }
  .opening-focus .opening-workbench { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .75rem; }
  .opening-focus .opening-line-heading { order: 0; }
  .opening-focus .opening-lesson-toolbar { order: 1; }
  .opening-focus .opening-coach { order: 2; }
  .opening-focus .opening-board { order: 3; }
  .opening-focus .opening-training { order: 4; }
  .opening-focus .opening-notes { order: 5; }
  .opening-lesson-toolbar > span { flex-basis: 100%; order: 3; }
  .opening-focus .opening-coach-question { font-size: 1rem; margin: .4rem 0; }
}

.opening-journey-stages li[aria-current="step"] { color: #f6d894; border-color: var(--brass); }
.opening-reply, .opening-recap { padding: .7rem; margin-top: 1rem; border-left: 3px solid var(--brass); background: #372c1e; font-size: .85rem; }
.opening-reply p { margin: .35rem 0 0; }
.opening-board { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; border: 3px solid #57452d; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; }
.opening-board-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; padding: .75rem 0; }
.opening-board-controls span { min-width: 60px; text-align: center; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-move-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem; max-height: 165px; overflow-y: auto; background: #211b15; border-radius: 6px; padding: .5rem; }
.opening-library .opening-move-strip button { border-color: transparent; padding: .25rem .4rem; min-height: 36px; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-move-strip button[aria-current="step"] { color: #1b1712; background: var(--brass); }
.opening-study-actions, .opening-training-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-top: 1rem; }
.opening-library .opening-primary { background: var(--brass); color: #21190c; border-color: var(--brass); font-weight: 600; }
.opening-notes { border-top: 1px solid #54432f; margin-top: 1.5rem; padding-top: 1.2rem; }
.opening-notes h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; color: #ead5ad; }
.opening-notes p, .opening-notes li { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-notes ul { padding-left: 1.1rem; margin-top: .5rem; }
.opening-notes li { margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.opening-plan-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.3rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
.opening-library .opening-small { font-size: .75rem; color: #b5aa94; }
.opening-variant-note, .opening-hint { border-left: 3px solid var(--brass); padding: .7rem; background: #372c1e; border-radius: 3px; }
.opening-training { padding-top: 1rem; }
.opening-color-choice { display: flex; gap: .5rem; align-items: center; font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-training progress { width: 100%; height: 7px; accent-color: var(--brass); }
.opening-training form { display: flex; align-items: end; gap: .5rem; margin-top: .8rem; }
.opening-training form label { display: grid; gap: .35rem; flex: 1; font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-feedback { color: #e8cd91; min-height: 1.5em; font-size: .9rem; }
.opening-practice-stats { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-trap-list { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
.opening-trap-list > p { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .85rem; }
.opening-trap-list article { border: 1px solid #5b4830; background: #231d16; border-radius: 7px; padding: 1rem; }
.opening-trap-list article p { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-library .opening-back-link { margin-bottom: .8rem; font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-source { font-size: .72rem; color: #b5aa94; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
.opening-source a { color: var(--brass); }
.opening-source details { margin-top: .6rem; }
.opening-source summary { cursor: pointer; }
.opening-source pre { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: .68rem; }
.opening-course-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 1.5rem; margin: 1rem 0 2rem; }
.opening-course-header h1 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem,3vw,2.4rem); margin: .3rem 0 .6rem; }
.opening-course-header p { color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-course-header button { flex-shrink: 0; }
.opening-course-search { display: grid; gap: .5rem; max-width: 500px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-family-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: .7rem; }
.opening-library .opening-family-card { display: grid; gap: .7rem; text-align: left; padding: 1.2rem; background: var(--panel); }
.opening-family-card span { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .8rem; }
.opening-course-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
.opening-course-card { padding: 1.4rem; border: 1px solid #51432f; background: var(--panel); border-radius: 9px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: start; }
.opening-course-card h2 { font-size: 1.35rem; margin: .3rem 0 .7rem; }
.opening-course-card p:not(.opening-eyebrow) { color: var(--bone-dim); font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.6; }
.opening-course-card button { margin-top: auto; }
.opening-focus .opening-layout { display: block; }

.opening-focus .opening-line-heading { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-bottom: 0; }
.opening-lesson-toolbar { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .8rem; padding-bottom: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #51432f; }
.opening-lesson-toolbar > span { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }

.opening-lesson-toolbar details[open] { flex-basis: 100%; padding: .8rem; border: 1px solid #51432f; border-radius: 6px; }
.opening-lesson-toolbar details button { margin: .4rem .5rem .2rem 0; }
.opening-focus .opening-board { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3 / span 2; max-width: 620px; align-self: start; }
.opening-focus .opening-coach { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; border: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; margin: 0; }
.opening-focus .opening-coach h3 { margin-top: .3rem; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-focus .opening-coach-question { line-height: 1.7; font-size: 1.12rem; border: 0; padding: 0; }
.opening-focus .opening-training { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 4; padding: 0; align-self: start; }
.opening-focus .opening-notes { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: .2rem; }
.opening-focus .opening-reply { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-focus .opening-opponent { border-left: 2px solid #78603c; padding: .1rem 0 .1rem .8rem; margin: .5rem 0 1rem; font-size: .88rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-focus .opening-recap { border-left-width: 2px; }
.opening-notation { margin: .7rem 0; }
.opening-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; margin: .6rem 0; }
.opening-library .opening-option input { width: auto; accent-color: var(--brass); }
.opening-branches { margin: 1rem 0; padding-top: .6rem; border-top: 1px solid #51432f; }
.opening-branches summary, .opening-other-routes summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--brass); font-size: .85rem; padding: .5rem 0; }
.opening-branch-options { display: grid; gap: .5rem; }
.opening-branch-options button { display: grid; gap: .4rem; text-align: left; }
.opening-branch-options span { font-size: .73rem; color: var(--bone-dim); }
.opening-other-routes { margin-top: 1rem; }
.opening-other-routes button { display: block; width: 100%; margin: .5rem 0; text-align: left; }
.opening-practical-list { margin: 1.5rem 0; padding-top: .8rem; border-top: 1px solid #51432f; }
.opening-practical-list summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--brass); }
.opening-practical-list button { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; margin: .6rem 0; }
.opening-arrow-key { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem .8rem; font-size: .7rem; margin: .2rem 0; }
.opening-arrow-key span:nth-child(1) { color: #f38c82; }
.opening-arrow-key span:nth-child(2) { color: #e8c36a; }
.opening-arrow-key span:nth-child(3) { color: #74c8b3; }
.opening-turn-review { display: grid; gap: .8rem; padding: .5rem 0; }
.opening-turn-review section { border-left: 2px solid var(--brass); padding-left: .75rem; }
.opening-turn-review h4 { margin: 0 0 .35rem; color: var(--brass); font-size: .85rem; }
.opening-turn-review p { margin: .35rem 0; font-size: .85rem; line-height: 1.5; }

  .opening-library { padding: .75rem; }
  .opening-hero { gap: 1rem; }
  .opening-totals { padding-left: .8rem; }
  .opening-totals strong { font-size: 1.6rem; }
  .opening-totals span { font-size: .65rem; max-width: 95px; }
  .opening-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
  .opening-results { max-height: 250px; }
  .opening-workbench { padding: .75rem; }
  .opening-hero h1 { font-size: 1.45rem; }
  .opening-hero p:last-child { font-size: .8rem; }
  .opening-line-heading h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
  .opening-plan-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: .5rem; }
  .opening-course-header { display: block; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
  .opening-course-header button { margin-top: .7rem; }
  .opening-family-grid, .opening-course-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .opening-course-card { padding: 1.1rem; }

.opening-focus .opening-notes { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: .2rem; }

.opening-focus .opening-recap { border-left-width: 2px; }
.opening-notation { margin: .7rem 0; }

.opening-branches summary, .opening-other-routes summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--brass); font-size: .85rem; padding: .5rem 0; }
.opening-branch-options { display: grid; gap: .5rem; }
